geez: በጥሕ ፡ ቍስሎሙ ፡ ወያውጽእ ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡ ሦከ ፡ ወአሜከላ ።

amharic: ፲፫፤ ከዚያም ፡ በኋላ ፡ ብዙ ፡ ደቀ ፡ መዛሙርት ፡ ወደርሱ ፡ ተሰበሰቡ ፤ በተጋድሎም ፡ ተጠመዱ ፤ ከእርሳቸውም ፡ የመጀመሪያው ፡ አባ ፡ ዘሩፋኤል ፡ ነው ።

notes: Page 74 verified. Abba Samuel of Waldebba: caring for wild beasts, disciples (Abba Zerufael), meeting Abba Gebre Meskel of Debre Legaso, heavenly liturgy with the 24 Priests of Heaven, Mary giving gem and incense, St. Michael carrying him to heaven, peaceful rest, and Arke.
